recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Today I rise as Sister Lois's son. My mother, Lois Sanders, was a proud Black woman who through her life tried to show and teach us that women were equal to us. They were not supposed to walk behind us, not supposed to do any of that stupid stuff, that they will walk equal with us. And you don't have to be a woman to support women.
